textRuns.value: Reading a 990 in four stops: Part I = the summary page (revenue, expenses, net assets) · Part VIII = revenue detail (line 1h total contributions, line 2 program service revenue) · Part IX = functional expenses (columns: A total, B program, C management, D fundraising - line 25 totals) · Part X = balance sheet (lines 27/28 = net assets without/with donor restrictions). Schedules: B donors (not public), D endowment & DAFs, I grants made. JSV's filings: tab 11 links (ProPublica, EIN 94-2222989).
